How it works

A small script updates the numbers once a day.

1. CollectSpotify totals and daily streams from Kworb, and video views from YouTube.
2. CompareToday's count is saved next to yesterday's, so each daily gain is the difference.
3. PredictThe site shows progress and how many days each goal will take.
